name: 3.26 Mercenaries
description: Brings 3.26 Mercenaries of Trarthus to every class: permanent mercenaries, all unique slots including body armour, optional all-zone spawning from Mud Flats, and configurable Luminary bonuses.
author: mrnamwen

nativeClient.rawAccessJustification: Hooks GetPlayerAscendancyRow (0x242d3f0) and CanMercenaryEquipItem (0x2480d70) via HookEngine pre-chains to show the Encounter Hire button for all classes and allow Unique Body Armour on permanent mercenaries when the mercenaries326 server mod is active.
